desc:
Marisa stole all the magic bookmarks that double as paperweights. 😤

Thinking about it... what if the whole elemental magic with Patchouli isn't actually her specialization, but just grimoires she had on hand at the time? Like imagine just the other day you managed to beat her ***「 Emerald Megalith 」*** – but then today she pulls out a ***Fist Sign...***
